discription: Detuned saw wave pad sound with a long attack and release envelope for a lush texture. Uses three detuned saw oscillators.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, detune=0.005, pan=0;    var sig, env;    var freqs = freq * #[1, 1+detune, 1-detune];    var gains = amp / 3;    env = EnvGen.ar(        Env.adsr(2.0, 1.0, 0.7, 3.0, curve: -4),        gate: gate,        doneAction: 2    );    sig = Mix.new(        freqs.collect { |f| Saw.ar(f) }    ) * gains * env;    Out.ar(out, Pan2.ar(sig, pan, 1));}
